name: Italian
notes: Five courses, usually starting with ITAL 151. The page names no fixed list beyond that, so any ITAL course at 151 or above counts here.
ITAL 207 is the summer program in Italy.

requirementGroups.label: Five Italian courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: The minor in Italian requires five courses, usually starting with ITAL 151: Intermediate Italian I. This may include ITAL 152: Intermediate Italian II, ITAL 207: Sustainability, Food & Local Cultures (Summer Program in Italy), and a variety of other options from 200-level Italian courses.
